title: An exchange underground
hook: Compare the effects on both participants.

knows: Ecological interactions can affect participants differently.
doesNotKnow: Both partners receive benefits in the stated exchange, a mutualistic interaction. Mycorrhizal relationships vary across conditions.

misconception: An interaction must affect both participants in the same way.
objective: Classify the stated effects of an ecological interaction.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: In this mycorrhizal association, the fungus receives plant carbon while the plant obtains mineral nutrients through the fungus. Using + for benefit, − for harm and 0 for no appreciable effect, which signs describe Fungus and Plant root, in that order? Fungus: +; Plant root: +. Both partners receive benefits in the stated exchange, a mutualistic interaction. Mycorrhizal relationships vary across conditions.
claims.source: Stipulated simplified example; ecological definitions: OpenStax https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/45-6-community-ecology

claims.text: Icons and signs summarize the stipulated interaction and do not quantify fitness or capture every ecological effect.
